DOES NOT HOLD. The deposited script sets no seed, so the published 93 per cent is one unseeded draw and the comparison is against the distribution rather than against a point. Across ten seeds the rewrite runs 97.7 to 99.6 per cent and 93 lies below every one of them. The error runs against the article's own interest: a higher share correctly signed is stronger evidence of homogeneity. The archive was deposited in June 2018 when dbarts 0.9-3 was current, and dbarts NEWS records four later repairs to multithreaded sampling, so the gap may belong to the sampler rather than to the analysis.
HOLDS. The deposited script sets no seed, so the published 77 per cent is one unseeded draw. Across ten seeds the rewrite runs 75.6 to 79.5 per cent and 77 sits near the middle.
